confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate without inspecting live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain. Cocktail and wine are estimated from beer-relative pricing because direct knowledge is weak. Hostel anchors are least certain because Montego Bay has relatively few registered hostels. Hotel anchors vary widely by season and resort tier. The FX value comes from RBA data reported in a search-result summary; I did not open the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Caribbean resort towns such as Negril and Ocho Rios, where tourist pricing is often quoted in USD. Jamaica is grouped under Latin America and the Caribbean, so the region is set to Latin America.
